title: Adomni Self-service DOOH & Video Advertising Inventory Marketplace

facts.fact: Adomni's vendor page claims that users can plan and launch optimal ad campaigns across DOOH and video channels in 5 minutes or less.
facts.quote: In 5 minutes or less, plan and launch optimal ad campaigns across digital out-of-home (DOOH) and video channels

facts.fact: Adomni's homepage states that it has delivered more than 60,000 campaigns.
Adomni's vendor page claims access to more than 1 million digital screens for DOOH advertising.
Adomni's vendor page claims more than 100 billion monthly DOOH impressions.
Adomni's vendor page claims access to more than 40 DOOH screen types.
Adomni's vendor page claims access to more than 1,000 DOOH publishers or media owners.
Adomni's vendor page claims more than 3.2 trillion monthly video impressions across its CTV and online video inventory.
Adomni's website states that its Stand Out campaign offering has no campaign minimums.
facts.quote: No campaign minimums • Same-day launch • Up and running in minutes with Jeen AI-assisted planning.

facts.fact: Adomni's Bubly case study reports an incremental household lift of 17% from its DOOH summer campaign (vendor-reported).
facts.quote: Saw an incremental household lift of 17%

facts.fact: Adomni's Stella & Chewy's case study reports a 33% lift in store visits among audiences exposed to the DOOH ads (vendor-reported).
facts.quote: Saw a 33% lift in store visits from audiences who were exposed to the DOOH ads

facts.fact: Adomni's Mucinex case study reports that combined CTV+DOOH exposure drove 3.4x higher web visit rates than DOOH alone (vendor-reported).
facts.quote: CTV+DOOH exposure drove 3.4x higher web visit rates vs. DOOH alone

facts.fact: Adomni's Thorne case study reports an over 70% lift in purchase intent (vendor-reported).
Adomni's FanDuel case study reports a 543% lift in registrations (vendor-reported).
Adomni's self-service plan includes credit card payments as a payment option.
Adomni lists patent 11,954,706 and patent 11,514,474 in its website footer.
